# Cloudflare RAG Portfolio – AI coding guide

> **Pivot in progress (epic #30).** The sections below describe the **current, deployed** single-turn
> RAG pipeline. The project is moving to a Cloudflare-first **agentic** architecture (Agents SDK on
> Durable Objects, curated corpus, trace panel, eval reporting, red-team mode). Before writing code
> that touches retrieval/generation, read
> [`docs/spec/spec-agentic-rag-portfolio.md`](../docs/spec/spec-agentic-rag-portfolio.md),
> [`docs/decisions/adr-20260807-agents-sdk-runtime.md`](../docs/decisions/adr-20260807-agents-sdk-runtime.md),
> and [`docs/status/doc-audit-agentic-rag.md`](../docs/status/doc-audit-agentic-rag.md) — the last one
> tells you whether the file you're about to touch is being replaced and when. Do not extend
> `basic-rag.ts`/`document-store.ts`/`ingestion-workflow.ts` with new features; those are slated for
> replacement, not enhancement.

- Big picture: single Cloudflare Worker serves both API (Hono) and built React assets; current entrypoints are [src/index.ts](../src/index.ts) for routes and [src/patterns/basic-rag.ts](../src/patterns/basic-rag.ts) for the (soon-to-be-replaced) RAG pipeline.
- Runtime/bindings: AI (Workers AI), D1 (`DATABASE`), Vectorize (`VECTOR_INDEX`), R2 (`ARTICLES_BUCKET`), KV caches, Workflows (`INGESTION_WORKFLOW`), and Agents SDK DO (`RAG_AGENT` → `RAGAgent`) are configured in [wrangler.jsonc](../wrangler.jsonc); Vectorize/D1/R2 are remote-only, `nodejs_compat` is enabled, and cron runs nightly at 02:00.
- Env knobs (wrangler vars): `LOG_LEVEL`, `ENABLE_TEXT_SPLITTING`, `DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE`/`DEFAULT_CHUNK_OVERLAP`, `DEFAULT_TOP_K`, `MAX_QUERY_LENGTH`, `CHAT_LOGGING_ENABLED`, and `CHAT_LOG_IP_SALT`.
- Dev loop: run `npm run dev` (Worker on 8787) and `npm run ui:dev` (Vite on 3000 with `/api` proxy per [ui/vite.config.ts](../ui/vite.config.ts)); build UI with `npm run build` (outputs to `public/`).
- Deploy: `npm run deploy` builds UI, applies remote D1 migrations, then `wrangler deploy --env production`; migrations live in [migrations/](../migrations/) and should be applied before code relying on them.
- Testing/tooling: `npm test` runs Vitest with Workers pool; `npm run cf-typegen` updates Cloudflare types.
- Current RAG flow (legacy comparison path at `/api/v1/query`): [basicRAG](../src/patterns/basic-rag.ts). **Agentic path** (Phase 3 / #34): [RAGAgent](../src/agents/rag-agent.ts) on Agents SDK with `retrieve_from_corpus` tool + trace events synced to the SPA trace panel. Model IDs: [src/config/models.ts](../src/config/models.ts).
- Reusable infra (keep building on these regardless of pivot phase): structured logging + trace context — [src/utils/logger.ts](../src/utils/logger.ts), [src/utils/trace.ts](../src/utils/trace.ts) (W3C traceparent, `traceId`/`spanId` — the new trace panel must reuse these, not invent a parallel scheme); chat logging/privacy — [src/utils/chat-logger.ts](../src/utils/chat-logger.ts), [src/utils/privacy.ts](../src/utils/privacy.ts); security — [src/utils/security.ts](../src/utils/security.ts), [src/utils/rate-limiter.ts](../src/utils/rate-limiter.ts), [src/utils/validation.ts](../src/utils/validation.ts).
- API surface (current): `/api/v1/query` GET/POST; `/api/v1/agent/bootstrap` for trace ids; WebSocket agent at `/agents/ragagent/:session`; `/api/v1/ingest`; `GET /api/v1/corpus/:id`; `/health` and `/api/v1/docs` — all in [src/index.ts](../src/index.ts). Eval/red-team routes land per the spec as phases ship.
- Data prep: **curated corpus** in committed `data/corpus/` (~37 articles); static manifest at `ui/src/content/corpus-manifest.json` via `npm run corpus:build`. Ingest: `npm run ingest:corpus [worker-url]`. Legacy bulk fetch remains in `data/wikipedia/` (`npm run fetch-data`) for rebuilding corpus locally (`npm run corpus:build -- --copy`).
- Gotchas: Vectorize has no local mode—dev relies on remote resources; keep `public/` untracked (generated by UI build); ingestion workflow requires Worker to be running to accept POSTs.
